review_type: Fresh independent static visual reference comparison

identity.case_identity_verification: All four case metadata files match the assigned case name, round 1, run ID, binary SHA-256, source SHA-256, Scribe profile, detail route, and portrait 930 x 1240 logical capture.
identity.png_identity_verification: Get-FileHash SHA256 was applied to the unmodified candidate and reference PNG bytes. Each candidate hash matches its case evidence_hashes.screenshot.sha256, and each reference hash matches its case reference_sha256.
identity.comparison_scale: Candidate native captures are logical 1x at 930 x 1240. References are physical 2x at 1860 x 2480 and were compared at equivalent logical proportions.
identity.viewing_method: Each of the eight original PNG files was separately opened with tools.view_image and visually examined.

observations: The 384 logical-pixel information column and remaining-width directory retain the reference proportions. The cover occupies approximately 306 x 420 logical pixels at the same left/top placement.
Sixteen directory rows remain visible with approximately 60 logical-pixel spacing. The last row, page folio, and Next page action remain inside the viewport; no bottom dock is present.

The title uses a bold serif face, while synopsis text uses regular serif with approximately 31 logical-pixel line spacing. The synopsis wraps to four fully readable lines and does not collide with the tag chips.

Primary actions remain solid black with white text, secondary actions use thin outlines, and metadata remains gray. No clipped label, unexpected surface texture, or floating-surface shadow is visible.
intentional_differences: The cover's raster pattern and actual book values are permitted content differences.
The candidate tracking action omits the reference's linked-service count because this capture has no configured external tracking service.

observations: The migration sheet remains a separate white outlined surface, approximately 680 logical pixels wide, with its serif heading, divider, retention controls, cancellation action, and start area fully inside the viewport.
The actual empty offline result is clearly stated in the candidate with a search affordance. No fabricated destination rows or selected migration destination are shown.
The three separate toggles remain visible: preserve read state, preserve category, and remove original-source downloads. The first two are on and the third is off, matching the recorded state.

The Start migration action is visibly disabled, consistent with an empty migration_candidates array, empty migration_selected_id, and migration_can_start=false. The screenshot does not imply a successful operation.
The sheet has a clean white background with a thin black perimeter and no shadow or stippled backdrop. Surrounding directory content remains geometrically consistent with the default page.
intentional_differences: The reference shows illustrative destination candidates; the candidate has an actual empty offline-cache result.
The candidate preserves category without claiming to preserve an externally linked tracker that is not configured.
The missing destination selection controls and disabled start state follow the actual empty results rather than being treated as an implemented successful migration.

observations: The menu remains anchored beneath the top-right More trigger. Its approximately 342 logical-pixel width, white fill, thin black outline, and top-left placement agree with the reference.
The candidate displays four text-only rows, while the reference displays five icon-led actions. The final reference action for deleting all downloads is absent.

The candidate labels begin at approximately logical x=588; the reference uses that area for a monochrome action icon and begins labels around x=626. Every candidate row consequently loses the reference icon and text alignment.
The unavailable screensaver action is gray and explicitly marked unavailable, which truthfully distinguishes it from enabled actions.
No menu label is clipped. The shorter menu height is a consequence of the missing action and is not reported as an independent fixed-height defect.
intentional_differences: The screensaver action is explicitly unavailable rather than pretending that a device-specific operation is supported.
Action wording may describe the actual supported refresh and category operations.

observations: The separate tracking sheet retains the reference's approximately 640 logical-pixel width, white fill, thin outline, serif heading, and visible Done action.
AniList and MyAnimeList are each shown as unconfigured with a configuration action. No linked book, reading progress, score, or successful external authorization is fabricated.

The two compact service cards and their configuration buttons are fully visible. Their reduced height is consistent with the unconfigured content; the linked reference card has additional controls and therefore requires more height.
The card labels, state text, and button labels are readable without overlap or clipping. The sheet has no shadow or stippled background.
The case metadata declares tracking_authorization_implemented=false and documents the unavailable/configuration entry as intentional; the visual state is consistent with that bound.
intentional_differences: The reference's linked AniList reading controls are replaced by the actual unconfigured state.
Both service cards offer configuration entry rather than simulated login or authorization.
Sheet and card heights follow the reduced unconfigured content.

suggestions.description: Restore the contextual Delete all downloads action in the manga More menu.
suggestions.evidence: The reference contains a fifth row for deleting all downloads beneath the screensaver action. The candidate stops after four rows, and its modal_items contains only reload, migrate, category, and screensaver. The same case state records downloaded_count=9, so this is not explained by an absence of downloaded chapters.
suggestions.recommendation: Expose a contextual deletion entry for the current book when downloads exist, wired to the actual supported operation and any required confirmation. If the operation is unavailable, retain a clearly disabled action with an accurate reason instead of omitting the reference action.

suggestions.description: Restore the leading action icons and matching text gutter in the manga More menu.
suggestions.evidence: All candidate menu rows are text-only and begin around logical x=588. The reference places the refresh, migration, folder, screensaver, and deletion icons at that location and starts labels around x=626. The candidate therefore loses the reference's action iconography and shifts all row labels left by approximately 38 logical pixels.
suggestions.recommendation: Render the corresponding monochrome action icon in a consistent leading slot and align row labels with the reference gutter, while preserving the explicit gray unavailable state where applicable.

prior_finding_rechecks.observation: Fresh viewing shows regular serif synopsis text, approximately 31 logical-pixel line spacing, four readable wrapped lines, and tag chips below the paragraph. The prior overly heavy or compressed synopsis treatment is not present in this batch.

limitations: This review covers only the four assigned pairs and eight original PNGs; it does not assert that the entire review round is clean.

Only existing PNG and JSON files were read, SHA-256 values were collected with Get-FileHash, and the review JSON was written. No application, build, test, smoke test, runtime probe, Git operation, or product modification was performed.

Visual reachability is limited to the controls visible within the captured viewport. The provided static evidence cannot establish click behavior, configuration navigation, or successful migration execution.
No migration destination exists in the supplied candidate state, so candidate-row selection, a nonempty enabled migration start state, and migration completion were not demonstrated.

External tracking authorization is explicitly unimplemented. This review accepts truthful unconfigured/configuration-entry content and does not qualify external authorization or linked-service behavior.

The reference-set identity was supplied by the coordinator. Individual reference PNG hashes were independently checked against each case metadata file; the aggregate reference-set hash was not recomputed.
Reference PNGs were displayed by tools.view_image at its reported resized presentation. Geometry was compared at equivalent logical proportions, and hashes refer to the unchanged original files.
